WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM status_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
